templates.title: Three-phase contact progression
templates.description: A reusable three-step structure that preserves golfer-specific judgment.

phases.title: Transfer contact
phases.purpose: Carry the contact pattern into changing targets.
phases.rationale: Start with the smallest controllable pattern.
progressSignals: Three of five strikes begin near the intended line

phases.title: Setup and contact
phases.purpose: Create a repeatable starting shape and centred strike.
phases.rationale: Start with the smallest controllable pattern.
progressSignals: Three of five strikes begin near the intended line

phases.title: Target variation
phases.purpose: Use the pattern with different clubs and start lines.
progressSignals: Start line stays useful across two clubs
